headline: Who is working on what: host editing, HQ assignments and independent verification.
summary: Assignments below identify the agent or role, its concrete task, last-observed state, timestamp and next checkpoint. These are dated work updates, not a live process monitor. The legacy keep label is a staffing classification and must not be interpreted as running.

Current autonomous cycle 235148 is working on host event editing: recoverable validation errors and preserving the event timezone. A fresh supervisor heartbeat and changed host-edit implementation/test files were observed. The prior chat-safety cycle d12e5bb completed independent tests, typechecks, lint and build; its product changes remain local.

Owner-requested assignment reporting is now part of the operating contract and future cycle prompt: publish when tasks are selected, delegated, reassigned, prepared, blocked or completed. Do not carry old participants forward as active or invent specialists from planned roles. Preserve concurrent workstreams and owner decisions.

The clearer HQ assignment-card layout is prepared in local commit c71bb7e: name, task/outcome, reported update and snapshot timestamp precede the long report. Twelve HQ tests, web typecheck and mobile/desktop Chromium checks passed; owner note drafts survive rerenders. Production still uses its current layout, where this assignment data appears in the agent section. No new deployment or email was performed.
